The image is ready. Here's a summary:

**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the one and only view in `workspace.dsl` (validated OK via the Structurizr tools before rendering).

What the diagram shows, matching the model exactly:
- **Patron** `[Person]` — "Borrows books at the library."
- **Library** `[Software System]` — "Manages books and loans."
- Relationship: Patron → Library, "Browses the catalogue through" `[HTTPS]`

One transparency note: this environment has no internet access and no local rendering stack (no Java/PlantUML, Graphviz, Python, or Node, and I'm not root to install anything), so I couldn't run the actual PlantUML renderer. Instead I exported the view to PlantUML via the Structurizr MCP tools to confirm its exact contents, then hand-authored a C4-styled SVG (white background, `#444444` strokes/text, person glyph, left-to-right layout) from that definition. It's SVG rather than PNG for the same reason — no rasterizer is available — which you'd allowed for. If you can open it in a browser or any SVG viewer, it will display correctly; if you need a true PNG, run it through any SVG→PNG converter (e.g. `rsvg-convert SystemContext.svg -o SystemContext.png`) on a machine with one.
